## Overview

This script generates manuscript-oriented plots for part 1 from the official derived outputs:

- per-layer counts and direction of age-associated features,
- a multi-omic cancer similarity dendrogram using the layer set selected in `03_prepare_clustering.Rmd`,
- an RNA-seq Hallmark GSEA combined heatmap (currently unused in the main manuscript figure),
- within- versus between-organ-system pairwise distances by molecular layer.

The similarity dendrogram and within- versus between-organ-system comparison both rely on
`pancancer_clustering_results.rds`, which contains the layer-inclusion diagnostics,
retained-layer similarity matrices, the per-pair overlap floor used during averaging,
and the final hierarchical clustering. This script reads those outputs directly without
re-deriving them. Not every plot generated here is necessarily included in the published
manuscript, and final multi-panel assembly may be performed in Adobe Illustrator.

## Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
  library(ape)
  library(ggtree)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cba)
  library(reactable)
})
```

## Paths

```{r}
import_file <- here::here(
  "results", "derived", "part1", "01_import_official_results", "part1_imported_results.rds"
)

gsea_file <- here::here(
  "results", "derived", "part1", "02_rnaseq_hallmark_gsea", "rnaseq_hallmark_gsea_results.rds"
)

clustering_file <- here::here(
  "results", "derived", "part1", "03_prepare_clustering", "pancancer_clustering_results.rds"
)

missing_files <- c(import_file, gsea_file, clustering_file)[!file.exists(c(import_file, gsea_file, clustering_file))]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required inputs. Run the part-1 prep Rmds first:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

fig_dir <- here::here("results", "figures", "part1")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load official derived results

```{r}
part1_imported_results <- readRDS(import_file)
rnaseq_hallmark_gsea   <- readRDS(gsea_file)
pancancer_clustering   <- readRDS(clustering_file)
```

## Per-layer age-associated feature counts

```{r}
fig1a_long <- part1_imported_results$fig1a_long

p_fig1A <- ggplot(fig1a_long, aes(x = Cancer, y = Count, fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Positive" = "red", "Negative" = "blue"),
    labels = c(
      "Positive" = "Positive Age-Association",
      "Negative" = "Negative Age-Association"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Age-Associated Features",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Layer, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing       = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x         = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.background    = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x        = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position     = "bottom"
  )

p_fig1A

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "multiomics_age_association.pdf"),
  plot     = p_fig1A,
  width    = 7.5,
  height   = 5.25,
  units    = "in"
)

fig1a_axis_ranges <- fig1a_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Layer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    min_count = round(min(Count, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_count = round(max(Count, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

reactable(fig1a_axis_ranges)
```

## Multi-omic similarity dendrogram

The clustering is computed in `03_prepare_clustering.Rmd` from the four
retained layers (Methylation, RNA-seq, miRNA, SCNA), with a per-pair
feature-overlap floor applied during cross-layer averaging. This chunk only
renders the saved `hclust` object as an organ-system-annotated tree.

```{r}
hc_pw_opt <- pancancer_clustering$hclust

selected_tree_obj    <- ape::as.phylo(hc_pw_opt)
selected_orig_labels <- selected_tree_obj$tip.label
selected_clean_labels <- stringr::str_remove(selected_orig_labels, "^TCGA-")
selected_tree_obj$tip.label <- selected_clean_labels

selected_anno_df <- part1_imported_results$organ_annotations %>%
  dplyr::filter(Project %in% selected_orig_labels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = stringr::str_remove(Project, "^TCGA-")) %>%
  dplyr::select(label, Organ_System)

p_fig1B <- ggtree(selected_tree_obj, layout = "rectangular", branch.length = "none") %<+% selected_anno_df +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, align = TRUE, linetype = 0, offset = 0.3) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Organ_System), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Organ System",
    values = part1_imported_results$organ_palette
  ) +
  theme_tree2() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 0, 5, 5),
    text            = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm")
  )

selected_max_x <- max(p_fig1B$data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
p_fig1B <- p_fig1B + xlim(0, selected_max_x + 1.5)

p_fig1B

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "cancer_clustering_tree.pdf"),
  plot     = p_fig1B,
  width    = 4.5,
  height   = 5,
  units    = "in"
)
```

## RNA-seq Hallmark GSEA heatmap (currently unused in the manuscript)

Filtered combined heatmap: rows are Hallmark gene sets significant in at
least 6 cancers, grouped by the pathway-category scheme used elsewhere in the manuscript.
Within each category, rows are ordered by hierarchical clustering on the
signed enrichment scores (Pearson distance, Ward.D linkage, optimal leaf
ordering). Columns are clustered the same way using Euclidean distance.
Cell colors show direction-and-significance bins (±2 highly sig.
FDR ≤ 0.01, ±1 moderately sig. FDR ≤ 0.05, 0 not significant).

```{r}
# --- Pathway category mapping ------------------------------------------------
# Same pathway-category scheme used elsewhere in the manuscript. A few Hallmark
# labels need cleaning so they
# match the keys in `hallmark_category_map`.
clean_pathway_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    "Reactive Oxygen Species Pathway" = "ROS Pathway",
    "Il2 Stat5 Signaling"             = "IL2/STAT5 Signaling",
    "Tnfa Signaling Via Nfkb"         = "TNFA Signaling via NFKB",
    "Pi3k Akt Mtor Signaling"         = "PI3K/AKT/MTOR Signaling",
    "Interferon Alpha Response"       = "Interferon Alpha",
    "Interferon Gamma Response"       = "Interferon Gamma",
    .default = x
  )
}

hallmark_category_map <- c(
  # Proliferation
  "E2f Targets" = "Proliferation", "G2m Checkpoint" = "Proliferation",
  "Mitotic Spindle" = "Proliferation", "Myc Targets V1" = "Proliferation",
  "Myc Targets V2" = "Proliferation",
  # Immune
  "Allograft Rejection" = "Immune", "Complement" = "Immune",
  "Coagulation" = "Immune", "IL2/STAT5 Signaling" = "Immune",
  "Il6 Jak Stat3 Signaling" = "Immune", "Inflammatory Response" = "Immune",
  "Interferon Alpha" = "Immune", "Interferon Gamma" = "Immune",
  "TNFA Signaling via NFKB" = "Immune",
  # Metabolic
  "Adipogenesis" = "Metabolic", "Bile Acid Metabolism" = "Metabolic",
  "Cholesterol Homeostasis" = "Metabolic", "Fatty Acid Metabolism" = "Metabolic",
  "Glycolysis" = "Metabolic", "Heme Metabolism" = "Metabolic",
  "Oxidative Phosphorylation" = "Metabolic", "Peroxisome" = "Metabolic",
  "Xenobiotic Metabolism" = "Metabolic",
  # Stress / Damage
  "Apoptosis" = "Stress / Damage", "Dna Repair" = "Stress / Damage",
  "Hypoxia" = "Stress / Damage", "P53 Pathway" = "Stress / Damage",
  "ROS Pathway" = "Stress / Damage", "Unfolded Protein Response" = "Stress / Damage",
  "Uv Response Dn" = "Stress / Damage", "Uv Response Up" = "Stress / Damage",
  # Signaling
  "Hedgehog Signaling" = "Signaling", "Kras Signaling Dn" = "Signaling",
  "Kras Signaling Up" = "Signaling", "Mtorc1 Signaling" = "Signaling",
  "Notch Signaling" = "Signaling", "PI3K/AKT/MTOR Signaling" = "Signaling",
  "Tgf Beta Signaling" = "Signaling", "Wnt Beta Catenin Signaling" = "Signaling",
  # Hormone
  "Androgen Response" = "Hormone", "Estrogen Response Early" = "Hormone",
  "Estrogen Response Late" = "Hormone",
  # Cell State
  "Angiogenesis" = "Cell State", "Apical Junction" = "Cell State",
  "Apical Surface" = "Cell State", "Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition" = "Cell State",
  "Myogenesis" = "Cell State", "Pancreas Beta Cells" = "Cell State",
  "Protein Secretion" = "Cell State", "Spermatogenesis" = "Cell State"
)

assign_pathway_category <- function(pathway) {
  pathway <- clean_pathway_label(pathway)
  out <- unname(hallmark_category_map[pathway])
  out[is.na(out)] <- "Other"
  out
}

pathway_category_levels <- c(
  "Proliferation", "Immune", "Metabolic", "Stress / Damage",
  "Signaling", "Hormone", "Cell State", "Other"
)

# --- Significance filter -----------------------------------------------------
# Keep gene sets significant (FDR ≤ 0.05) in ≥ 6 cancers.
min_sig_cancers <- 20

sig_labels <- rnaseq_hallmark_gsea$gsea_best %>%
  dplyr::group_by(label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sig_cancers = sum(fdr <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_sig_cancers >= min_sig_cancers) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label)

threshold_matrix <- rnaseq_hallmark_gsea$threshold_matrix[sig_labels, , drop = FALSE]
score_matrix     <- rnaseq_hallmark_gsea$score_matrix[sig_labels, , drop = FALSE]

threshold_matrix[is.na(threshold_matrix)] <- 0
score_matrix[is.na(score_matrix)]         <- 0

# Apply pretty pathway names and strip TCGA- prefixes
rownames(threshold_matrix) <- clean_pathway_label(rownames(threshold_matrix))
rownames(score_matrix)     <- clean_pathway_label(rownames(score_matrix))
colnames(threshold_matrix) <- stringr::str_remove(colnames(threshold_matrix), "^TCGA-")
colnames(score_matrix)     <- stringr::str_remove(colnames(score_matrix),     "^TCGA-")

# --- Within-category row ordering -------------------------------------------
hcopt <- function(d, HC = NULL, method = "ward.D", members = NULL) {
  if (is.null(HC)) HC <- stats::hclust(d, method = method, members = members)
  ORD <- cba::order.optimal(d, merge = HC$merge)
  HC$merge <- ORD$merge
  HC$order <- ORD$order
  HC
}

row_categories <- assign_pathway_category(rownames(score_matrix))
names(row_categories) <- rownames(score_matrix)

row_order <- character(0)
for (cat in pathway_category_levels) {
  rows_in_cat <- names(row_categories)[row_categories == cat]
  if (length(rows_in_cat) == 0) next
  if (length(rows_in_cat) == 1) {
    row_order <- c(row_order, rows_in_cat)
    next
  }
  sub_score <- score_matrix[rows_in_cat, , drop = FALSE]
  sub_dist  <- as.dist(1 - stats::cor(t(sub_score), use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  sub_hc    <- hcopt(sub_dist, method = "ward.D")
  row_order <- c(row_order, rows_in_cat[sub_hc$order])
}

threshold_matrix <- threshold_matrix[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
score_matrix     <- score_matrix[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
row_categories   <- row_categories[row_order]

# --- Column clustering --------------------------------------------------------
col_dist <- stats::dist(t(score_matrix))
col_hc   <- hcopt(col_dist, method = "ward.D")

# --- Annotations and gap positions ------------------------------------------
organ_df <- part1_imported_results$organ_annotations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Project = stringr::str_remove(Project, "^TCGA-")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Project %in% colnames(threshold_matrix)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Project, colnames(threshold_matrix))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Project") %>%
  dplyr::select(`Organ System` = Organ_System)

category_df <- data.frame(
  `Pathway Category` = factor(row_categories, levels = pathway_category_levels),
  row.names = rownames(threshold_matrix),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Gaps between pathway categories
category_counts <- as.numeric(table(factor(row_categories, levels = pathway_category_levels)))
category_counts <- category_counts[category_counts > 0]
gaps_row <- head(cumsum(category_counts), -1)

# --- Colors -----------------------------------------------------------------
heatmap_colors <- c("blue", "lightblue", "white", "pink", "red")
heatmap_breaks <- c(-2.5, -1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 2.5)

category_palette <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"),
  pathway_category_levels
)

# --- Render ------------------------------------------------------------------
p_fig1C <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  threshold_matrix,
  color             = heatmap_colors,
  breaks            = heatmap_breaks,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,             # rows pre-ordered by category + within-cat clustering
  cluster_cols      = col_hc,
  gaps_row          = gaps_row,
  annotation_row    = category_df,
  annotation_col    = organ_df,
  annotation_colors = list(
    `Pathway Category` = category_palette,
    `Organ System`     = part1_imported_results$organ_palette
  ),
  annotation_legend = TRUE,
  legend            = FALSE,
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = TRUE,
  angle_col         = 45,
  fontsize          = 10,
  fontsize_row      = 9,
  fontsize_col      = 9,
  treeheight_row    = 8,
  treeheight_col    = 8,
  cellwidth         = 12,
  cellheight        = 9,
  main              = ""
)

# Save to PDF
pdf(
  file   = file.path(fig_dir, "pathway_gsea_heatmap_filtered.pdf"),
  width  = 11,
  height = 7
)
print(p_fig1C)
dev.off()
```

### Horizontal version (cancers as rows, pathways as columns)

matrices are transposed. Row names render on the right by default in

```{r}
threshold_matrix_h <- t(threshold_matrix)

# Pathway category factor in column order
column_categories <- factor(unname(row_categories), levels = pathway_category_levels)

# Annotations swap sides: pathway category becomes a column annotation,

category_df_h <- data.frame(
```

## Within- vs between-organ-system pairwise distance (per layer)

Per-pair distances are masked at the same per-pair feature-overlap floor used
in the clustering averaging step. Pairs below the floor in a given layer are
dropped from that layer's plot and from its permutation test. Each layer is
then evaluated on the cancers it measured, so the cancer set and the retained
organ systems are defined per layer and the panels differ in the number of
pairs they test. Significance is assessed by shuffling organ labels among that
layer's cancers, which holds the distance matrix fixed while breaking only the
organ assignment.

```{r within_between_organ_distances}
organ_lookup <- setNames(
  part1_imported_results$organ_annotations$Organ_System,
  part1_imported_results$organ_annotations$Project
)

# Masked pair-distance extraction. A pair is dropped (NA) for a layer if its
# per-pair feature overlap in that layer is below the clustering floor.
similarity_to_pair_df <- function(sim_mat, overlap_mat, organ_lookup,
                                  layer_label, min_overlap) {
  cancers <- colnames(sim_mat)
  d_mat   <- 1 - sim_mat
  d_mat[overlap_mat < min_overlap] <- NA

  ij <- which(upper.tri(d_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    cancer1  = cancers[ij[, 1]],
    cancer2  = cancers[ij[, 2]],
    organ1   = organ_lookup[cancers[ij[, 1]]],
    organ2   = organ_lookup[cancers[ij[, 2]]],
    distance = as.numeric(d_mat[ij]),
    layer    = layer_label
  )
}

layer_label_map <- c(
  "Methylation" = "Methylation",
  "RNAseq"      = "RNA-seq",
  "miRNA"       = "miRNA",
  "SCNA"        = "SCNA"
)

panel_levels <- unname(layer_label_map[pancancer_clustering$selected_layers])

min_overlap <- pancancer_clustering$thresholds$MIN_PAIR_OVERLAP

per_layer_pairs <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  pancancer_clustering$similarity_by_layer,
  function(sim, layer_id) {
    similarity_to_pair_df(
      sim_mat      = sim,
      overlap_mat  = pancancer_clustering$pair_overlap_by_layer[[layer_id]],
      organ_lookup = organ_lookup,
      layer_label  = layer_label_map[[layer_id]],
      min_overlap  = min_overlap
    )
  }
)

# Per-layer eligibility. Each layer is tested on the cancers it measured, so
# the cancer set comes from that layer's own pairs rather than from the
# clustered cancer set. Masking runs first: a pair below the overlap floor is
# already NA here, so a cancer whose pairs are all masked does not enter the
# layer. Organ systems with fewer than two cancers in the layer contribute no
# within-organ pairs and are dropped from that layer.
eligible_by_layer   <- list()
all_pairs_by_layer  <- list()
filter_summary_list <- list()

for (lyr in panel_levels) {
  layer_pairs <- per_layer_pairs %>%
    dplyr::filter(layer == lyr)

  layer_pairs_kept <- layer_pairs %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(distance), !is.na(organ1), !is.na(organ2))

  layer_cancers     <- union(layer_pairs_kept$cancer1, layer_pairs_kept$cancer2)
  layer_organ_n     <- table(organ_lookup[layer_cancers])
  layer_multi_organ <- names(layer_organ_n[layer_organ_n >= 2])

  eligible_by_layer[[lyr]] <- layer_cancers[
    organ_lookup[layer_cancers] %in% layer_multi_organ
  ]

  all_pairs_by_layer[[lyr]] <- layer_pairs_kept %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      cancer1 %in% eligible_by_layer[[lyr]],
      cancer2 %in% eligible_by_layer[[lyr]]
    )

  filter_summary_list[[lyr]] <- tibble::tibble(
    layer                 = lyr,
    n_cancers_in_layer    = length(union(layer_pairs$cancer1, layer_pairs$cancer2)),
    n_cancers_after_floor = length(layer_cancers),
    n_cancers_eligible    = length(eligible_by_layer[[lyr]]),
    n_organ_systems       = length(layer_multi_organ),
    n_pairs_in_layer      = nrow(layer_pairs),
    n_pairs_below_floor   = sum(!is.finite(layer_pairs$distance)),
    n_pairs_tested        = nrow(all_pairs_by_layer[[lyr]])
  )
}

all_pairs <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_pairs_by_layer) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_type = ifelse(organ1 == organ2, "Within Organ", "Between Organ"),
    pair_type = factor(pair_type, levels = c("Within Organ", "Between Organ")),
    layer     = factor(layer, levels = panel_levels)
  )

filter_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(filter_summary_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(layer = factor(layer, levels = panel_levels))

reactable(filter_summary)

sig_label <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ "n.s."
  )
}

N_PERM    <- 10000
PERM_SEED <- 20260731

empirical_two_sided_p <- function(observed, null) {
  null <- null[is.finite(null)]

  p_upper <- (1 + sum(null >= observed)) / (length(null) + 1)
  p_lower <- (1 + sum(null <= observed)) / (length(null) + 1)

  min(1, 2 * min(p_upper, p_lower))
}

rank_permutation_p <- function(distance, cancer1, cancer2, organ1, organ2,
                               eligible_cancers, perm_org_mat) {
  within  <- organ1 == organ2
  between <- !within
  ranks   <- rank(distance, ties.method = "average")

  observed <- mean(ranks[between]) - mean(ranks[within])

  idx1 <- match(cancer1, eligible_cancers)
  idx2 <- match(cancer2, eligible_cancers)

  if (anyNA(idx1) || anyNA(idx2)) {
    stop("Cancer matching failed in permutation test.")
  }

  within_perm <-
    perm_org_mat[idx1, , drop = FALSE] ==
    perm_org_mat[idx2, , drop = FALSE]

  n_within_perm  <- colSums(within_perm)
  n_between_perm <- length(distance) - n_within_perm
  valid           <- n_within_perm > 0 & n_between_perm > 0

  total_rank      <- sum(ranks)
  within_rank_sum <- colSums(within_perm * ranks)

  null <- rep(NA_real_, ncol(perm_org_mat))
  null[valid] <-
    (total_rank - within_rank_sum[valid]) / n_between_perm[valid] -
    within_rank_sum[valid] / n_within_perm[valid]

  empirical_two_sided_p(observed, null)
}

set.seed(PERM_SEED)

# Organ labels are shuffled among the cancers eligible in each layer, so each
# layer's null preserves its own organ-system sizes.
perm_org_by_layer <- list()

for (lyr in panel_levels) {
  layer_organs <- unname(organ_lookup[eligible_by_layer[[lyr]]])
  perm_org_by_layer[[lyr]] <- vapply(
    seq_len(N_PERM),
    function(b) sample(layer_organs, size = length(layer_organs), replace = FALSE),
    FUN.VALUE = layer_organs
  )
}

perm_per_layer <- all_pairs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(layer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value = rank_permutation_p(
      distance         = distance,
      cancer1          = cancer1,
      cancer2          = cancer2,
      organ1           = organ1,
      organ2           = organ2,
      eligible_cancers = eligible_by_layer[[as.character(layer[1])]],
      perm_org_mat     = perm_org_by_layer[[as.character(layer[1])]]
    ),
    n_within       = sum(pair_type == "Within Organ"),
    n_between      = sum(pair_type == "Between Organ"),
    median_within  = median(distance[pair_type == "Within Organ"]),
    median_between = median(distance[pair_type == "Between Organ"]),
    .groups        = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_label = sig_label(p_value),
    layer     = factor(layer, levels = panel_levels)
  )

utils::write.csv(
  perm_per_layer,
  file = file.path(fig_dir, "within_vs_between_organ_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable(perm_per_layer)

x_global_max <- max(all_pairs$distance, na.rm = TRUE)
x_global_min <- min(all_pairs$distance, na.rm = TRUE)
x_pad        <- (x_global_max - x_global_min) * 0.06

sig_anno_df <- perm_per_layer %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_position = x_global_max + x_pad)

pair_fill_values <- c("Within Organ" = "#4DAF4A", "Between Organ" = "grey75")

p_fig1D <- ggplot(all_pairs, aes(x = distance, y = pair_type, fill = pair_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.16, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_anno_df,
    aes(x = x_position, xend = x_position, y = 1, yend = 2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_anno_df,
    aes(x = x_position - x_pad * 0.3, xend = x_position, y = 1, yend = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_anno_df,
    aes(x = x_position - x_pad * 0.3, xend = x_position, y = 2, yend = 2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sig_anno_df,
    aes(x = x_position + x_pad * 0.3, y = 1.5, label = sig_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = pair_fill_values) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.22))) +
  facet_wrap(~ layer, ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  labs(
    x = "Distance (1 \u2212 Pearson)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", angle = 0),
    strip.background   = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing      = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

print(p_fig1D)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "within_between_combined.pdf"),
  plot     = p_fig1D,
  width    = 4,
  height   = 5,
  units    = "in"
)

scna_pairs <- per_layer_pairs[per_layer_pairs$layer == "SCNA", ]
scna_kept  <- scna_pairs[is.finite(scna_pairs$distance), ]

setdiff(
  union(scna_pairs$cancer1, scna_pairs$cancer2),
  union(scna_kept$cancer1, scna_kept$cancer2)
)
```
